question: By whose grace does this installation benefit all beings according to the verse?
premises: Akṣobhya is named in the verse.
Grace is stated as the operative cause.
inference: By the grace of Akṣobhya, this installation benefits all beings.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of akṣobhyaḥ to the rest of the line is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: Akṣobhya, by the grace of this installation, is for all beings.
